info.description: Backend for time registration, projects, and glossary management.
info.title: tireg API

post.description: Validates credentials and returns a signed JWT access token

get.description: Returns every glossary type and project owned by the authenticated user
Returns every glossary project owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new glossary project owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Updates a glossary project owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a glossary project owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns every glossary type owned by the authenticated user, seeding the defaults on first access

post.description: Creates a new glossary type owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Updates a glossary type owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a glossary type owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns the current health status of the service
Returns every task mapping owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new task/meeting classification rule owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns a single task mapping owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Updates a task mapping owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a task mapping owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns every time entry owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new time entry owned by the authenticated user, auto-filling project/type/issue from the owner's task mappings when left blank

get.description: Returns a single time entry owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Updates a time entry owned by the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a time entry owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new user account with a hashed password

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token returned by /api/v1/auth/login.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
